name: The Search for Who Stole Christmas
source:
This is a children's VN that tells the story of how a group of 5-year-old cupcake kids attempt to solve the disappearance of all things Christmasy on Christmas Eve. 

They are joined by Sandy Claws the teddy bear and go back in time to Victorian England where they interact with Dickens characters Scrooge, Artful Dodger, Oliver Twist, Inspector Bucket, and Mr. Bumble.

They also interact with Santa Claus and a couple of other characters on their way to recovering Christmas.
